consequence.statement: IPsec configurations using single key mode will automatically transition to per-tunnel keys; tunnel behavior may change depending on the per-tunnel key configuration.

original.statement: IPsec single key support (indicated by the + sign in secrets) has been removed; per-tunnel keys are now always used regardless of the + sign's presence.

decision.reason: [ev-a152c8cea30c] says single-key IPsec support is removed and that per-tunnel keys are now used whether or not the secret has the `+` sign. That describes a mechanism that changes automatically, not one that fails, rejects resources, ignores settings or needs a stated operator step. So behavior-change (review) is the kind the evidence supports; nothing there justifies a mandatory-work kind. Confidence is low because the excerpt also doesn't say outright that existing IPsec connectivity keeps working through the switch.
